card.name: Words just before a number in millions
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or punctuation right before an estimated quantity, such as "some", "about", "of", or "$", when a figure like "20 million" or "3 million" is about to follow. Found in general web text on populations, counts and sizes.

modes.label: Approximation words before a count
modes.description: Words like some, about, approximately or between that lead into a large rounded figure.

modes.label: Space or link before the figure
modes.description: A space, "of", "to" or "$" just before a big number of people, items or money.

card.writes: It promotes words for hundreds and suppresses million and similar words, so it steers away from a million-scale word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a large round number, like "about" before "3 million".
